title: Khilwat Mubarak, Chowmahalla Palace
geometryBasis: Native Khilwat way 116030267 fixes the hall envelope. Two exact May 2020 CC0 views and the palace description establish the yellow and white plaster, cusped arcade, rooftop pavilions and marble entrance steps.
sectionBasis: The original north courtyard ground defines model zero. Two dated exterior photographs guide the raised plinth, double-height arch proportions and pavilion tiers. Absolute facade and roof heights are estimates.
limitations: May 2020 exterior of the Khilwat Mubarak Durbar Hall. The clock tower, other palace buildings and interiors are separate.
The mapped footprint fixes the exterior envelope. The roof heights, rear elevations and ornamental relief are photographic estimates.
Original elevation samples are preserved. The north stair apron and plinth heights are approximations.
